item.tib: kun gsal byams ma chen mor 'jug thabs gsal byed 'phrul gyi lde mig
item.coloph: zhes kun gsal byams ma chen mo'i 'jug thabs gsal byed 'phrul gyi lde mig zhes pa 'di yang / 'di don la 'bad pa 'ga' yis nan cher bskur (bskul) ngor/ gshen bstan sman ri'i gdan sar gshen gyi drang srong nyi ma bstan 'dzin bdag gi (gis) sman ri bla brang du bris pas/ mnyam med bla ma'i bstan pa dar zhing rgyas pa'i rgyu ru gyur cig/
